hooks.name: Practice data check on save
hooks.description: When problem data (shared/practice/), a reference solution, or practice.py is saved: run the practice and counterexample tests and check the practice fixtures are current. Catches a reference that disagrees with its examples, a generator that yields an invalid input, or a search that no longer finishes in its 1.5 s budget.

action.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" || exit 1; if [ ! -x .venv/bin/pytest ]; then echo "practice check: .venv/bin/pytest not found. Create it with: uv venv .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -r requirements-dev.txt" >&2; exit 1; fi; out=$(.venv/bin/pytest -q --tb=short tests/test_practice.py tests/test_counterexample.py 2>&1); code=$?; echo "$out" | tail -25; if [ "$code" -ne 0 ]; then echo "practice tests FAILED (exit $code)" >&2; exit 1; fi; fx=$(.venv/bin/python frontend/src/py/gen_fixtures.py --check 2>&1); fcode=$?; if [ "$fcode" -ne 0 ]; then echo "$fx" | tail -10; echo "practice fixtures are stale: run .venv/bin/python frontend/src/py/gen_fixtures.py --all" >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "practice data ok: tests pass and fixtures are current"
